headline: Several injured as Chhatra Dal and Shibir clash at Dhaka Alia Madrasah
summary: Activists from both groups reportedly fought over control of the institution's residential halls in the Bakshibazar area.
details: Several people were injured this afternoon in a clash between activists of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) and Islami Chhatra Shibir at Government Madrasah-e-Alia, also known as Dhaka Alia Madrasah.
The confrontation reportedly broke out over a dispute regarding control of the institution's residential halls, leading to heightened tensions across the campus.
Witnesses reported that activists from both sides were seen carrying pipes and sticks during the clash.
Social media videos showed members of the rival groups armed with locally made weapons engaging in chases and counter-chases before the fight began.
Dhaka Metropolitan Police Assistant Commissioner (Chawkbazar Zone) Md Mahfuzar Rahman confirmed the incident, noting that the two groups had taken positions on campus despite the presence of police.
Law enforcement agencies eventually intervened and brought the situation under control.
caption:

headline_marked: Around [[50 injured in clashes]] at Jagannath University
headline: Around 50 injured in clashes at Jagannath University
summary: Student groups including Chhatra Dal, Shibir, and Chhatra Shakti clashed on campus, leading to the formation of a university investigation committee.
details: Clashes broke out between members of JCD, Shibir, and Chhatra Shakti, as well as JOKSU and Chhatra Shakti, at Jagannath University in Dhaka.
Reports indicate that around 50 students were injured during the violent encounters, with both sides claiming scores of their members were hurt.
The university administration responded to the incident by forming a four-member investigation committee to conduct a fair probe into the 'unwanted incident'.
The campus remained tense as multiple rounds of clashes hit the institution, disrupting the academic environment.
